task: regress the Friedman #1 function from noisy samples
dataset: synthetic Friedman #1, 10 Uniform(0,1) features (x1..x5 signal, x6..x10 noise), Gaussian noise std=1.0
split: frozen: seed=7, n_train=400, n_test=200; every node uses this exact split
eval_script: stdlib OLS / ridge / polynomial features on the frozen split; no numpy

knobs.alpha: ridge L2 on non-intercept coefficients; ols must be 0; poly may set alpha>0

protocol.note: mean squared error on frozen test
mean absolute error on frozen test
coefficient of determination on frozen test
train MSE; gap vs test_mse flags overfit
